description: Figure 7, titled "mBERT XLM-RoBERTa comparison by language family," is a bar chart that compares the performance of mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa models across different language families. The chart displays the number of cases where one model outperforms the other (labeled "mBERT better" and "XLM-R better") and the number of cases where their performance is the same (labeled "same"). The horizontal axis categorizes the data by language family, while the vertical axis represents the count of cases. The bars are color-coded: light blue for "mBERT better," dark blue for "XLM-R better," and light green for "same." The chart shows that for most language families, XLM-RoBERTa performs better than mBERT, with the "XLM-R better" bar being the tallest in most categories. The "same" category has a consistent, low count across all language families. The "mBERT better" category has a very low count, indicating that mBERT only outperforms XLM-RoBERTa in a few instances. The language families are listed along the x-axis, but the specific names are not visible in the provided image.
